THE CLINICAL PICTURE

Medical exercise testing starts with the right platform.

A medical treadmill is the exercise component of a treadmill test (TMT) or exercise stress ECG setup. It creates a controlled workload while a separate compatible ECG system records the heart’s electrical activity. The CARDIO-TRACK brochure describes a purpose-built range with a cushioned deck, substantial handrails and computer interfaces for medical environments. Choose the treadmill together with your ECG workstation, room layout and clinical requirements.

For professional healthcare use. This overview supports equipment selection; operation requires the current manufacturer instructions and trained clinical staff.

DESIGNED AROUND YOUR WORKFLOW

Practical advantages.
Clearer equipment decisions.

Look beyond a product name. Match the capabilities to the people, space and systems in your facility.

Purpose-built support

Long main and side handrails offer patients a support surface during supervised walking. The low-profile front hood helps keep the forward view open.

Controlled exercise workload

Model-specific speed and incline ranges let clinical teams select equipment around their exercise protocols. Test stages must be set by the supervising team.

A cushioned walking deck

The brochure describes a cushioned deck, thick belt and large roller drum, features intended for comfort and regular institutional use.

Computer connection options

RS232 and RS485 interfaces are listed. Your ECG software, cable, communication protocol and selected treadmill must be checked together.

A choice of capacities

Select among brochure-listed user capacities of 150 kg, 180 kg and 210 kg rather than assuming every treadmill supports the same patient load.

Designed for clinical rooms

Heavy-duty construction and an emergency stop switch are described in the brochure. Confirm all safety functions on the exact supplied model at handover.

HOW IT IS USED

A supervised workflow,
from preparation to review.

An orientation for buyers and clinical teams. Exact operating steps depend on your supplied equipment and software.

  1. 01

    Check readiness

    Qualified staff assess patient suitability and confirm the prescribed test protocol. Inspect the belt, rails, emergency stop, power connection and ECG communication before use.

  2. 02

    Prepare the patient and ECG

    The clinical team prepares skin and electrodes, records baseline observations and explains walking, rail use and how to report symptoms. Use the ECG manufacturer’s instructions.

  3. 03

    Run the supervised examination

    Staff operate the selected clinical protocol, monitor the patient and ECG, and control workload through the approved setup. The clinician determines when exercise must stop.

  4. 04

    Complete recovery and reporting

    Continue observation during recovery as directed by the clinical team. Save the ECG results in the separate diagnostic system, then clean and inspect the treadmill according to its manual.

Clinical context

Exercise stress testing evaluates the heart during physical effort. Patient selection, monitoring and interpretation belong to the responsible clinical team. Patients should follow their clinician’s preparation instructions and should not change medication on the basis of this page. Read the American Heart Association overview ↗

PLAN THE COMPLETE SYSTEM

A treadmill and an ECG system need to work together.

The brochure lists interfaces with several historical stress-test manufacturers. That list does not establish compatibility with every present-day system. Provide the exact ECG device, software version, treadmill model and communication requirements before purchase. Request a documented integration check or demonstration. Pairing with the custo cardio 300 must be verified for the specific software, interface and treadmill configuration; it is not assumed on this page.

Cleaning & ongoing care

Keep the walking surface and surrounding floor clear and follow the manufacturer’s cleaning procedure. Trained service personnel should inspect belt tracking, tension, moving parts, electrical safety and emergency stop operation at the intervals in the supplied manual. Do not use equipment with visible damage, abnormal movement or a failed safety check.

YOUR QUESTIONS, ANSWERED

Before you choose.

Practical answers for clinical and procurement teams.

What is a TMT machine used for?

A TMT setup supports supervised exercise stress testing. The treadmill provides exercise workload; a separate ECG system records electrical activity. A clinician decides whether the test is appropriate and interprets the result.

Is the treadmill a complete ECG stress-test system?

No. An ECG acquisition device, compatible diagnostic software, workstation and appropriate clinical monitoring are separate requirements unless explicitly included in your quotation.

Which model should our clinic choose?

Compare maximum patient weight, walking area, speed range, incline, available floor space and ECG compatibility. The 900EXL has the largest walking area and highest user capacity in the supplied table; the best choice depends on your facility.

What is the CARDIO-TRACK TMT machine price in the UAE?

A current price is available by quotation. State the model, quantity, delivery emirate and whether you need an ECG workstation, installation or training. Confirm VAT, delivery charges and all inclusions in writing.

Can it connect to our existing ECG software?

Possibly, but the RS232/RS485 connections alone do not prove compatibility. Ask for confirmation for your device, software version, protocol and interface cable before placing an order.

Can patients use it without clinical supervision?

This page describes professional clinical equipment. Exercise stress testing requires an appropriately equipped setting and qualified supervision; this buying guide is not an operating manual or a home-testing guide.

Does the price include installation and warranty?

Only the written quotation can establish those inclusions. Ask for commissioning, operator training, warranty terms, preventive maintenance and local service availability as separate line items.

Can Fastonmed supply it to our emirate?

Share your UAE delivery location, access restrictions and required date with Fastonmed. Current availability, transport, installation coverage and lead time need confirmation for your order.
